title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar, 16-Inch Double Tier - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Need more bathroom storage without giving up counter space? This wall-mounted double glass shelf adds two levels for everyday essentials and an integrated towel bar for a clean, coordinated setup.

  • Keep essentials organized and accessible with a double-tier glass shelf design.
  • Keep items secure thanks to the solid brass gallery rail around the shelves.
  • Add towel space in the same footprint with the integrated towel bar.
  • Maintain a finished look on the wall with concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Coordinate your bathroom with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place and other transitional bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions: 16-Inch length x 5-Inch projection x 12-Inch height
  • Glass: 0.38 in (3/8-Inch) thick tempered glass
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Material: brass (solid brass hardware)
  • Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw mounting; screw size #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finishes: multiple designer finish options available

Need more bathroom storage without giving up counter space? This wall-mounted double glass shelf adds two levels for everyday essentials and an integrated towel bar for a clean, coordinated setup in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces.

  • Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Add towel space in the same footprint with the integrated towel bar.
  • Maintain a finished look on the wall with concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Coordinate your bathroom with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place and other transitional bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions: 16-Inch length x 5-Inch projection x 12-Inch height
  • Glass: 0.38 in (3/8-Inch) thick tempered glass
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Material: brass (solid brass hardware)
  • Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw mounting; screw size #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finishes: multiple designer finish options available
